about: Russian strings for the math and export areas of notes/i18n/inventory.json (299 math + 221 export base + 171 export provisional from work/xr). Keyed by inventory id. ru follows GLOSSARY.md. Review round 2 fixes: math_src/fixes_r2.py. LaTeX, $…$ math, TeX commands and {placeholders} are identical to en; Russian notation (tg, sh, ln, …) is applied by I18N.notation() at the display boundary, so the table keeps \tan, \sinh, \log. U+00A0 marks no-break spaces (before an em dash, after one-letter words, «Рис. 1»). plural: Intl.PluralRules("ru") forms; where en has no {n}, the plural forms introduce {n} and the key must become a $tn() key. ru_short: proposed shorter label where the full one risks overflow. Fragment entries (kind caption/latex with leading or trailing spaces) are written so that, glued in the English order, they read as correct Russian; notes say where a whole-sentence template or a case form is still needed.

math.both_sides_equation_must.en: Both sides of an equation must be real numbers: here they are complex, and no curve was found where both their real and imaginary parts agree (a complex equation usually holds only at isolated points). Take Re, Im, |·| or arg of each side, e.g. Re z = 0, |z − 1| = 2 or arg z = π/4. For the isolated points where the sides agree, write |A − B| = 0 (for z³ = 1: |z^3 − 1| = 0).
math.both_sides_equation_must.ru: Обе части уравнения должны быть вещественными: здесь они комплексные, и не найдено кривой, на которой совпадают и их вещественные, и мнимые части (комплексное уравнение обычно выполняется лишь в изолированных точках). Возьмите от каждой части Re, Im, |·| или arg, например Re z = 0, |z − 1| = 2 или arg z = π/4. Чтобы получить изолированные точки, где части совпадают, напишите |A − B| = 0 (для z³ = 1: |z^3 − 1| = 0).

math.equation_does_not_involve.ru: Уравнение не содержит z, поэтому не задаёт кривую.

math.two_sides_are_equal_2.en: The two sides are equal for every z, so the equation does not pick out a curve.
